design_status: exploratory_saved_history_comparison; prior histories/results observed; not confirmatory
primary_question: Compare supplied-parameter simple-law discrimination with the saved fitted feedback detector under a matched fixed reference bank

alternative_generating_fit.message: CONVERGENCE: RELATIVE REDUCTION OF F <= FACTR*EPSMCH

law.null_rule: Same a,d,n,productivity ratio,beta,trigger,stress law with eta=0; mark likelihood cancels

phase1.oracle_statistic: L=ell(eta*)-ell(0), signed unscaled ground log likelihood ratio; predictable event log ratios plus complete compensator difference
phase1.fitted_statistic: Saved D=2*(NLL_ml_null-NLL_ml_separate_scale); no refit; calibrate on the same999 nullreference IDs separately

calibration.ties: >=, exact floating values, no rounding or randomization

clock.policy: Preserve each accepted authoritative likelihood convention. Ordinary projected-lag scoring when recorded high times are strictly increasing; null_0841 uses saved paired high/low+positive gaps throughout; null_1292 retains original projected-time scoring despite carrying extra clock fields.
clock.interpretation: Numerically evaluated known-parameter contrast under recorded conventions; not a rigorous exact finite-precision observation-law Neyman-Pearson bound

numerical.order64_rule: Only after failed16/32 gate and within frozen remainingcase/global budget; accept iff abs(L64-L32)<=1e-6 elseunknown
numerical.subtraction_crosscheck: Independent original likelihood subtraction on fixed nonextreme validation fixtures; no cancellation-based primary scoring

ordering_sensitivity.classification: reject only if upper possible rank<=.05; nonreject only if lower possible rank>.05; elseunknown
ordering_sensitivity.scope: Predeclared refinement-sensitivity envelope; not a certified numerical error bound or a confidence interval

failure_policy.missing_reference: Withhold every inference/decision for that statistic; no complete-subset calibration
failure_policy.missing_query: Retain fixed identity and full denominator as unknown; no replacement, zero assignment, or completecase filtering
failure_policy.ordinary_estimates: CP and Bernoulli MCSE only for complete fixed cohort; paired gain/MCSE only if both decisions resolve for all cohort members
failure_policy.bounds: For arm withkknownreject,uunknown,Nplanned: [k/N,(k+u)/N]; pair difference uses eachknowncomponent and unknown[0,1]

report.primary_power: Conditional on the realized999-reference bank, known generating parameters and declared clock/numerics
report.heldout_size: Separate1000 nullcheck IDs, never calibrated or in-sample ranks
report.arm_intervals: Exact two-sided95% Clopper-Pearson for conditional Bernoulli rejection probability; not parameter/modeltruth intervals
report.paired_comparisons: Oracle-minus-saved-fitted detection frequency, paired table, sampleSD(delta)/sqrt(N) descriptive MCSE for alternative and nullcheck cohorts separately
report.bank_uncertainty: Conditional CP omits reference-bank threshold uncertainty; unconditional exchangeability/rank bound is distinct and does not establish plug-in bootstrap validity

interpretation_criteria.size_screen: For each detector CP95 contains.05 and rejection-frequency point estimate in[.025,.075]; warn if absolute oracle/fitted size difference>.02. This is a descriptive screen, not proof of equal size or joint level.
interpretation_criteria.low_oracle: If oracle complete150 power CP95 upper<.50, flag weak known-parameter discrimination for this pair/horizon; no rigorous oracle power bound.
interpretation_criteria.strong_pipeline_contrast: Only after bothsize screens and pointsize gap<=.02: oracle power CP95 lower>.80 and oracle-minus-fitted power gain>=.20 and gain>=2*pairedMCSE flag strong loss in fitting/search/test pipeline; not attribution to a nuisance block.
interpretation_criteria.otherwise: Report continuous estimates and uncertainty as intermediate/unresolved; do not force a binary explanation or change eta. A positive gap alone cannot distinguish estimation, search, thresholding and finite optimization effects.
interpretation_criteria.phase2_needed: Only controlled ablations can assign losses to particular nuisance blocks; finite-path10.82/3.26% geometry is prior evidence, not causal explanation.
